title: NovaOS v2.4.2 (Tablet Optimization & Crash Patch)
summary: This release delivers crucial tablet UI scaling optimizations for the Nova Touch interface, unlocks edge-to-edge app grid bounds, and implements robust guardrails against random animation lifecycle crashes.

newFeatures: Nova Touch Full-Width Mode: Refactored layouts for wider screen profiles (sw600dp and sw720dp) to use match_parent formatting, letting the App Drawer canvas map seamlessly edge-to-edge across tablet monitors.

Dynamic Tablet Grids: Upgraded the layout measurement rules inside AllAppsContainerView.java. Tablets now automatically compute two extra columns of icons when rotated into horizontal landscape mode to fully utilize tablet real estate.
optimizations: Streamlined Tablet Insets: Bypassed background card paddings and search margins when running on non-phone configurations, creating a sleek, integrated look for the tablet interface.
bugFixes: Overview Mode Null Guardrails: Guarded the launcher overview panels and transitional states against unexpected null pointers during quick navigation adjustments inside Launcher.java.

Animation Lifecycle Crash Fixes: Injected structural safety logic inside LauncherStateTransitionAnimation.java and WorkspaceStateTransitionAnimation.java to prevent crashes when a user navigates away or clears views right as an alpha fade animation loops.

title: NovaOS v2.4.1 (Stability & Performance Patch)
summary: This patch update squashes visibility bugs in the app drawer search interface, optimizes text contrast tracking across highly transparent backgrounds, and introduces pre-compiled baseline profiles for snappier performance.

newFeatures: Dynamic Search Input Themes: The app drawer search bar text and placeholder hint colors now automatically adapt alongside the main text palette to guarantee maximum readability.
Optimized Alpha Contrasting: Overhauled the background luminance tracking calculations inside Utilities.java to safely handle highly transparent color bounds without dropping color consistency.
optimizations: Added ART Baseline Profiles: Bundled native compilation profiles (.dm) for modern API targets (SDK 28 through 31+), significantly reducing layout rendering overhead and boosting app launch speeds on initial install.
Workspace Initialization Hooks: Polished cell layout insertions inside Workspace.java to ensure pull-down action elements trigger reliably during layout generation.
bugFixes: Fixed Clear Background Text Blindness: Resolved a rendering bug where heavily translucent or transparent app drawer backgrounds would accidentally force white text against light wallpapers.
Manifest Refinement: Cleared out accidental trailing comments within the core android manifest declarations.

title: NovaOS v2.4.0 (The Customization Update)
summary: This release is packed with highly requested desktop visual customization options, smoother rendering engine logic, and robust quality-of-life stability fixes for managing your home screen layout.

newFeatures: Custom Icon Shapes: Select between System Default, Circle, Square, Squircle, or Teardrop shapes in launcher preferences.
Taskbar Color Selection: Manually set your Taskbar (Hotseat) color to Red, Blue, Green, or Solid Black directly from the settings.
Adjustable Taskbar Transparency: Scale background opacity from a solid 0% clear layout up to a completely translucent 100% overlay.
Custom Icon Image Picker: Long-press an icon inside the Edit App Dialog to select any custom image file from phone storage.
Adaptive Text Contrasting: Added an automatic luminance engine that reads the App Drawer background darkness and flips text colors between White and Black for readability.
optimizations: Dynamic Graphics Reloading: Implemented centralized cache clearing listeners so icon shapes and taskbar changes update instantly without requiring a manual launcher refresh.
Enhanced Outline Mask Filter Engine: Refactored HolographicOutlineHelper logic to better calculate blurred borders around adaptive shapes.
Manifest Target Upgrade: Bumped internal target configurations to targetSdkVersion 35 while preserving backward flexibility down to SDK 21.
bugFixes: Foolproof App Uninstallation: Overhauled UninstallDropTarget logic with multi-tier fallback intents to guarantee the system uninstallation handler executes flawlessly on all device configurations.
Drag & Drop Crash Prevention: Fixed a critical rendering vulnerability where initiating a drag-and-drop workflow on zero-width widgets or folders would crash the workspace.
Crash Fix on Drag Cancel: Resolved a common code crash that occurred if a user suddenly canceled a drag state immediately after an uninstallation event triggered.
